tldr: Jupiter through the 11th house expands friends, groups, community, networks, and future plans.
body:
When Jupiter moves through your 11th house, it makes more room around friends, groups, audience, networks, community, hopes, and where you belong. You may notice who you are connected to, which groups still feel alive, and what kind of future you want to be part of.

Hope, appetite, confidence, opportunity, and risk can all get bigger. It can help you say yes to something that gives your life more range.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for seeing where belonging supports you and where it has become performative.

The caution: Watch for taking on more than the situation, your schedule, or your judgment can hold. The risk is staying attached to a group, plan, or audience that no longer fits.

Jupiter moves through this house for about a year. Let the opening be real, but keep your promises sized to the life you can actually live.
